You speak of them going to school. I feel, then, it's the school's fault. The school should not -- that's the point of a school, the older people are trying to help the younger. They're not trying to stand up there and say, I want to learn this and the teacher say, okay, I'll teach you. Do you want to be a thorough musician? Then this is what you do and don't tell me what to do, or you don't need to come to this school.
